AutoRenew.description_en:
Whether auto-renewal is enabled for the node. Valid values:

true: Auto-renewal is enabled.

false: Auto-renewal is disabled
AutoRenew.description_zh:
节点是否自动续费。取值范围：
true：已开启自动续费。
false：未开启自动续费
AutoRenew.title: 节点是否自动续费。

AutoRenewDuration.description_en: The auto-renewal duration for the node
AutoRenewDuration.title: 节点自动续费时长。

AutoRenewDurationUnit.description_en: The unit of the auto-renewal duration
AutoRenewDurationUnit.description_zh: 节点自动续费时长单位
AutoRenewDurationUnit.title: 节点自动续费时长单位。

CreateTime.description_en: The creation time of the node
CreateTime.title: 节点创建时间。返回状态使用。

ExpireTime.description_en: The expiration time of the node
ExpireTime.title: 节点过期时间。

InstanceType.description_en: The instance type of the node. This corresponds to an ECS instance type. You can call the ECS [DescribeInstanceTypes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25620.html） operation to query the available instance types
InstanceType.description_zh: 实例类型。对应ECS的实例类型，您可以通过调用ECS服务的[DescribeInstanceTypes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25620.html）获取可用的实例类型
InstanceType.title: 实例类型。

MaintenanceStatus.description_en:
The maintenance status of the node. Valid values:

ON: The node is in maintenance mode.

OFF: The node is not in maintenance mode.

If this parameter is empty, the node is not in maintenance mode
MaintenanceStatus.description_zh:
运维模式状态。取值范围：
ON：处于运维模式。
OFF：处于非运维模式。

为空表示处于非运维模式
MaintenanceStatus.title: 运维模式状态。

NodeGroupId.description_en: The ID of the node group
NodeGroupId.title: 节点组ID。

NodeGroupType.description_en:
The type of the node group. Valid values:

MASTER: A master node group.

CORE: A core node group.

TASK: A task node group
NodeGroupType.description_zh:
节点组类型。取值范围：
MASTER：主节点组类型。
CORE：核心节点组类型。
TASK：计算节点组类型
NodeGroupType.title: 节点组类型。

NodeState.description_en:
The state of the node. Valid values:

Pending: The node is being created.

Starting: The node is starting up.

Running: The node is operational and running services.

Stopping: The node is shutting down.

Stopped: The node is powered off.

Terminated: The node has been permanently deleted
NodeState.description_zh:
节点状态。取值范围：
Pending：创建中。
Starting：启动中。
Running：运行中。
Stopping：停止中。
Stopped：已停止。
Terminated：已终止
NodeState.title: 节点状态。

PrivateIp.description_en: The private IP address of the node
PrivateIp.title: 私网IP。

PublicIp.description_en: The public IP address of the node
PublicIp.title: 公网IP。

description_en: Queries the node list of an EMR cluster
kebab_example: aliyun emr list-nodes --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --cluster-id c-b933c5aac8fe0000 --next-token DD6B1B2A-5837-5237-ABE4-FF0C89568980 --max-results 20 --node-group-ids ng-869471354ecd0000 --node-ids i-bp1cudc25w2bfwl50000 --node-names core1-1 --private-ips 10.10.10.8 --public-ips 42.1.1.00 --node-states Running --tags example-string --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListNodes

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region in which you want to create the instance
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: Marks the current position where reading starts. If you set this value to null, you can start from the beginning
parameters.help_zh: 标记当前开始读取的位置，置空表示从头开始
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The number of maximum number of records to obtain at a time. Valid values: 1 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 一次获取的最大记录数。取值范围：1~100
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: An array that consists of information about the ID of the node
parameters.name: node_ids

fields.help_en: The key of the tag. This parameter is required and cannot be an empty string. The key can be up to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:` and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh: 标签键。必填参数，不允许为空字符串。最多支持128个字符，不能以```aliyun```和```acs:```开头，不能包含```http://```或 ```https://```
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The value of the tag This parameter is optional and can be an empty string. The value can be up to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with `acs:` and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh: 标签值。非必填，可以为空字符串。最多支持128个字符，不能以```acs:```开头，不能包含```http://```或者```https://```
fields.name: value

MaxResults.title_zh: 本次请求所返回的最大记录条数。

NextToken.title_zh: 返回读取到的数据位置。

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of records in this request
